Template fields

Journal and conference publications · Loop over publications for a flat list or groups to group by year. Each pub includes every named column in its worksheet. Use {{ pub.journal_title }} for journals or {{ pub.conference_proceedings }} for conferences. Access the original value by header, for example {{ pub.excel['Conference proceedings'] }}.

Use {{r pub.title_with_link }} and {{r pub.doi_with_link }} for hyperlinks. The formatted citation pub.citation and normalized URL pub.doi_url are also available.

Activities · Loop over activities and use activity.title, activity.date, activity.year, activity.team, activity.description, activity.contacts, and activity.activity_urls.

PhD theses · Loop over theses and use thesis.author, thesis.title, thesis.supervisors, thesis.year, and thesis.team.

Theses in progress · Loop over theses and use thesis.author, thesis.title, thesis.supervisors, thesis.team, and thesis.enrollment. Use {{ theses | length }} for the total.

Projects · Loop over projects and use project.acronym, project.title, project.reference, project.funding_entity, project.call, project.start, project.end, project.amount_display, project.ips, and {{r project.link_text }}.

Keep each Jinja tag intact when editing the template. You can change the styles and the surrounding text.
